sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT, the wall check (below 30 %)
light sensor LLIGHT, the dark check (below 70 %)

control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 30 %, look at the side sensors and curve away from a wall; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive straight forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: on black curve left, otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through a tunnel without hitting its walls.

branches.reason: The light sensors read 100 % in the open and never less than 40 % inside a tunnel, so below 30 % never happens in the simulator.
branches.outcome: the light is below 30 %: it checks the side sensors
the light is 30 % or more: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is on the left (first) or on the right (second)

uncertainties: Your side-wall check runs only when the light is below 30 %, but a tunnel never gets darker than 40 %: in the dark your program drives straight on.

In bright light with nothing ahead it follows a line and stops at a wall; your sentence doesn't mention that.
